rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a person or situation marked by bad luck.

example.english: I'm really unlucky today—it started raining as soon as I left home.
example.traditional: 我今日真係唔好彩，出門口就落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 coi2 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zau6 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice especially for a person who keeps having bad luck or is having a bad run.

example.english: I've been so unlucky lately that I even spilled a cup of milk tea.
example.traditional: 我呢排黑仔到連買杯奶茶都打瀉。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ni1 paai4 hak1 zai2 dou3 lin4 maai5 bui1 naai5 caa4 dou1 daa2 se3

rows.note: Use this when an object, event, or action is regarded as bringing bad luck or being an unlucky omen.

example.english: Saying the word “death” at a wedding is unlucky.
example.traditional: 喺婚禮度講個死字好唔吉利。
example.jyutping: hai2 fan1 lai5 dou6 gong2 go3 sei2 zi6 hou2 m4 gat1 lei6
